scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @lan-send/protocol && concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run dev --workspace @lan-send/server" "npm run dev --workspace @lan-send/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @lan-send/protocol && npm run build --workspace @lan-send/server && npm run build --workspace @lan-send/web
scripts.check: npm run build --workspace @lan-send/protocol && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: node --conditions=development --import tsx --test packages/protocol/test/*.test.ts apps/server/test/*.test.ts apps/web/src/lib/*.test.ts apps/web/test/*.test.ts
